notes: All website prices are an exported PUBLIC customer-price snapshot; private factory cost, manager commissions and markup factors are never in this repository.
Base display prices rounded to nearest whole RUB; factory financials remain inside the owner's protected Google workbook.
Add-ons with no unequivocal matching DOCX line item are quote-by-request; must never be assigned old prices or shown as zero.
Terraces, insulation, stove replacements, installation and site-specific works require a separate confirmation and are not silently added.
Changes to the bundle: contains unpriced options, therefore the bundle total is quote-by-request until its scope is fully approved.
Viking base models include a 2.4m arched central entrance per owner's direction, priced as 30000 ₽ RRP in the private calculation; public catalog contains only the final base amounts.
Kvadro center-protruding entrance needs the owner's confirmation; the source DOCX only lists a side entrance. The Kvadro base matrix is NOT changed until its exact price is approved.
Kvadro 5m comfort adds 10.5 m² of 50mm floor insulation by the latest source DOCX rate; the normal Kvadro base remains without insulation.

pricingAdjustments.policy: Final site-column amounts are already complete. Never add historic uplifts again.
